newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-JGBs seen steady,eyes on deposit insurance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-JGBs seen steady,eyes on deposit insurance.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: drainage of 200 bln yen

*JGB prices are likely to be steady. *Traders are worried about the impact on the stock market from a local media report that MOF started considering guaranteeing principals of financial instruments which are currently outside of the protection by Deposit Insurance Corp. *If Tokyo stocks are cheered by the report, the JGB upside may be limited.
